profile.name: Hwoarang
profile.overview: Hwoarang is a heavy-hitting rush down character, using strong plus frames and multitude of stances to force opponents into a torrent of snap defensive decisions - many of them granting Hwoarang huge damage potential.
profile.playstyle: Heavy-hitting rushdown through four stances. Use plus-on-block moves and stance transitions (RFF, LFS, RFS) to keep a torrent of pressure going and make sidestepping hard. Wavu warns his stances take time to learn, and almost every attack is a punch or kick, so parries and power crushes can hurt him.
strengths: Overwhelming offensive pressure with his multiple stances, rapid attacks, and plus on block transitions, making sidestepping against him tricky to pull off
Can armor through pressure with an assortment of armor moves and strings
Can approach the opponent while armored with his df3 cancel
Multiple tricky and effective strings to stack chip damage
Not a grappler, yet has full throw game, an 11 frame throw and even an air-throw, arguably the best throw game for any non-grappler in the game
One of the best 11 frame punishers in the game in his 4,3, and an alternative 4,4 which can go into stance
Plasma Blade is one of the best whiff punishers in the game
Has arguably the best mid launcher in the game in Just Frame Skyrocket (JFSR), safe on block and 16 frame startup
weaknesses: Learning the ins and outs of his four stances can be challenging
Almost all of his attacks are punches or kicks, making him weak to parries and reversals
Loses his throw game almost completely in stances (all stance throws are 1+2 breaks)
Must use unsafe lows to condition opponents to crouch to make mids effective
Requires above average execution on tools like the Just Frame Skyrocket (JFSR) and his wavedash, which does not have a conventional built-in mixup

stances.name: Right Foot Forward
stances.entry: 3+4, and many moves transition to it (f+2, df+4, f,F+3)
stances.note: RFF.2,3 is an i10 wall-splat punish (Wavu); RFF.3~4 is a homing power crush; RFF.df+3 is a Heat Engager.

stances.name: Left Flamingo Stance
stances.note: LFS.f+3 is a Heat Engager and +4 on block; LFS.uf+4 tornadoes.

stances.name: Right Flamingo Stance
stances.note: RFS.b+3 is a Heat Engager; RFS.uf+4 tornadoes. In Heat, several RFS strings become natural combos (Wavu).

stances.name: Left Foot Forward
stances.note: The standing stance most of his moves come from.

heat: RFS.f+4,4, RFS 4,3, and RFS.d+4,3,4 become natural combos.

sources.name: Wavu Wiki
sources.note: Community-maintained frame data. Values can lag behind the latest patch; verify in Practice mode frame display.

keyMoves.summary: Right Jab: i10, +0 on block, can transition to LFS with 3.
keyMoves.gamePlan: His jab goes into stance pressure.

keyMoves.summary: i10 jab string, the start of his i10 punishes (Wavu lists 1,2,3 and 1,2,4).
i13 mid, -1 on block (also from RFF).
Rusty Knife: i16 mid, -2 on block, transitions to RFF.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid into stance pressure.

keyMoves.summary: Right Hook Kick: i17 high, +7 to +13 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A very plus high that keeps the turn.
keyMoves.gamePlan: A key pressure tool: mix it with mids.

keyMoves.summary: Right Uppercut: i15 launcher, -7 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His i15 launch punisher, safe on block.
keyMoves.avoid: Against crouchers: only +4s on normal hit.
keyMoves.counterplay: Duck it if they spam it.

keyMoves.summary: Chonsan Spin: while-standing tornado string, +3 on block.
Iron Heel: i14 while-standing mid, -12 on block.
Firecracker: i20 low into a high that tornadoes, -13 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A low with a launch follow-up.
keyMoves.counterplay: Block low, duck the second hit.

keyMoves.summary: Sweep Kick: i19 low, -13 on block.
Peacekeeper: i17 mid Heat Engager, -7 on block.
Sky Rocket: i16 tornado from a crouch dash. The just-frame version is -8 on block.
Pickpocket: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2.

combos.name: Launch BnB: f+4~RFS.3~4 d+4,4 T! uf+3,4,3
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as df+2.
mistakes: Not cancelling f+4 into RFS quickly enough.
Doing d+4,4 too slowly after the stance kick.
